$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|$Nu, as-tu fini de t'entraîner
pour aujourd'hui ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Pour l'entraînement physique, oui. Mais je
voulais encore me pencher sur la théorie.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|Tu devrais te détendre un petit peu... Avec
l'expérience, tu verras que c'est important.$k$pDans une guerre comme celle-ci, on ne sait
jamais quand aura lieu la prochaine bataille.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Oui, j'ai eu l'occasion de m'en apercevoir.$k$pAvec tout ce qui s'est passé récemment,
nous avons à peine eu le temps de manger.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|La route a été dure, c'est vrai.
Et j'ai bien peur que ça ne s'arrange pas.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Je vais me ménager et me reposer, alors.
Je ne voudrais pas perdre ce teint de rose...$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Euh...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Quoi ? Vous trouvez cela étrange ?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|Euh, non... Simplement, je...$k$pJe ne me suis jamais dit que tu étais
du genre à te soucier de ton teint...$k$p$E通常,|C'est que je ne t'ai jamais vraiment
considérée comme une dame...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Pardon ?!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|Euh... Je veux dire... Je ne voulais pas...
Enfin, il y a « dame » et « dame », tu vois ?$k$pNous nous battons et parlons stratégie...
Non pas qu'une dame ne puisse se battre...$k$pBon sang, je devrais me taire, je ne dis
que des âneries...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|Voyons, Chrom ! N'êtes-vous pas
l'héritier d'une noble famille ?$k$pNe vous a-t-on jamais enseigné les bonnes
manières dans vos écoles réputées ?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|Bien sûr qu'on m'a enseigné l'étiquette...
pendant tout un semestre, même.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Un autre semestre pour apprendre à parler
aux dames ne serait pas de trop, on dirait.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_6|Dans mon idée, une dame est quelqu'un de
guindé... Toute parfumée, toute jolie...$k$pRien à voir avec toi ! Le mot « dame » ne
me vient pas à l'esprit quand je te vois...$k$p$E怒,汗|Euh... $Nu ? Tu comptes faire
quoi, avec cette pierre ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvjSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_36|$SveSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|Je me disais qu'un bon coup sur la tête
vous remettrait les idées en place.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_3|N... Non, attends ! Je plaisantais ! Ha ha ?
Euh... Je dois y aller !$k
$Wsクロム|$Wd$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_40|Je n'en crois pas mes yeux !
Ce couard a pris ses jambes à son coup !$k$pIl n'a vraiment pas de manières !$k$p$E通常,|Hmm... Après tout, je lui rends bien.$k$pJe ne le traite pas non plus comme un noble
distingué ou un gentilhomme...$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|Bist du mit dem Training für heute fertig,
$Nu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Just in diesem Moment. Ich wollte mich als
nächstes ein wenig meinen Studien widmen.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|Du solltest erst etwas rasten und die Füße
hochlegen.$k$pErfahrene Soldaten ruhen sich aus, wann
immer sie dazu die Gelegenheit haben.$k$pBei einem Feldzug wie diesem kann man nie
wissen, wann die nächste Schlacht droht.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Ja, das ist mir aufgefallen.$k$pIn letzter Zeit ist so viel passiert, da hatten
wir kaum genug Zeit zum Schlafen.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|Es war beschwerlich, stimmt. Und uns steht
sicher noch Schwierigeres bevor.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Nun, ich werde es ruhig angehen lassen.
Eine Dame braucht ihren Schönheitsschlaf.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Äh...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Was ist? Habe ich etwas Seltsames gesagt?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|Äh, nein... Vermutlich nicht.
Nicht direkt jedenfalls.$k$pIch hielt dich nur nicht für jemanden, der
sich aus derlei Dingen viel macht.$k$p$E通常,|Und ich hielt dich nie wirklich für eine
Dame.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Wie bitte?!?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|Nein! So war das nicht gemeint! Es ist nur:
Du tötest Leute, wälzt dich im Dreck und...$k$pOh, Ihr Götter! Das klingt alles so falsch.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|Gute Güte, Chrom. Du bist der Erbe einer
Adelsfamilie, oder?$k$pHaben sie dir auf deinem Nobelinternat
denn gar keine Manieren beigebracht?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|Bei den Göttern, und ob! Wir haben uns ein
ganzes Semester lang mit Etikette befasst.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Ein Semester, das du offensichtlich
verschlafen hast.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_6|Ich weiß, ich weiß. Weißt du, bei dir denke
ich nicht zuerst an eine "Dame".$k$p$E怒,汗|...Äh, $Nu?
Was... Was hast du mit dem Stein da vor?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvjSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_36|$SveSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|Ich glaube, ein fester Schlag auf den Kopf
würde dir wieder etwas Vernunft einbläuen.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_3|N-nein, warte! Es war bloß ein Scherz!
Haha... ha? ...Ich muss weg!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wd$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_40|Ich fasse es nicht. Der kleine Feigling ist
tatsächlich weggelaufen!$k$pDer hat wohl echt keine Manieren, oder?$k$p$E通常,|Ach, was soll's. Ist wohl nur gerecht.$k$pSchließlich halte ich ihn auch nicht für einen
Kavalier oder für einen modischen Adligen.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|Hai finito il tuo allenamento
di oggi, $Nu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Sì, proprio ora. Adesso pensavo
di ripassare un po' di strategia.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|Dovresti provare a rilassarti. Anche i soldati
più esperti riposano appena possono.$k$pIn una campagna così dura, non si sa mai
quando scoppierà la prossima battaglia.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Sì, me ne sono accorta.$k$pCon tutto quello che è successo, abbiamo
avuto poco tempo persino per mangiare.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|Non è un cammino facile, il nostro.
E col tempo diventerà ancora più ostico.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Non affatichiamoci troppo, allora. Il sonno
è un elisir di bellezza per noi donne.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Ehm...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Che c'è? Ho detto qualcosa di sbagliato?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|No... Direi di no. È solo che...$k$pNon pensavo che fossi tipo da
preoccuparsi di certe cose.$k$p$E通常,|In effetti, penso di non aver mai
pensato a te come a una donna.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Come scusa?!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|Non fraintendermi! Tu SEI una donna, anche
se non nel senso classico del termine...$k$pSai combattere, sai guidare una battaglia...
Cioè, anche le ragazze combattono, però...$k$pUff! Mi sto arrampicando sugli specchi.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|Per tutti gli dei, Chrom. Sei il rampollo
di una famiglia nobile, non è così?$k$pNessuno ti ha insegnato le buone maniere
in tutte quelle scuole eleganti e costose?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|Oh, ma certo. Abbiamo dedicato un intero
semestre a studiare il galateo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Allora, forse potresti dedicarne un altro
ad imparare come si parla a una donna.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_6|È solo che immagino una donna come una
creatura a modo, graziosa, profumata...$k$pNiente a che fare con te! Quando ti guardo,
non vedo una "donna", capisci?$k$p$E怒,汗|Ehi? Ehm, $Nu?
Cosa intendi fare con quella pietra?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvjSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_36|$SveSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|Penso che un colpo dritto in testa
potrebbe correggerti la vista.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_3|N-No, aspetta! Stavo scherzando...
Ah ah! È meglio che vada!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wd$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_40|Non posso credere che quel
codardo sia appena fuggito!$k$pNon conosce affatto le buone
maniere, nemmeno un po'!$k$p$E通常,|Beh, in fondo è giusto così.$k$pNeanch'io lo considero un gentiluomo,
tanto meno un nobile principe.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|¿Ya has acabado el entrenamiento de hoy,
$Nu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|He terminado las prácticas de combate.
Pero pensaba repasar un par de libros...$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|Deberías relajarte y tirarte a la bartola. Un
soldado veterano descansa cuanto puede.$k$pEn una campaña como esta, nunca sabes
cuándo se iniciará la siguiente batalla.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Sí, ya me he dado cuenta.$k$pCon todo lo que ha pasado últimamente,
casi no hemos tenido tiempo ni de comer.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|Sí, no ha sido un camino de rosas.
Y la cosa solo puede ir a peor.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Siempre que puedo intento echar una
cabezada.$k$pA fin de cuentas, una dama necesita dormir
para estar bella.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Eeeh...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|¿Qué pasa? ¿He dicho algo raro?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|Eeeh, no... No es eso... Es solo que...$k$pEs que no pareces el tipo de persona que
suele preocuparse por esas cosas.$k$p$E通常,|Supongo que nunca he pensado en ti
en esos términos, como una "dama"...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|¡¿Perdona?!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|¡No! Es que... Quería decir... una "dama
corriente"... Esto...$k$pYa sabes, como luchas y planeas estrategias
y todo eso...$k$pNo digo que una dama no pueda combatir,
pero...$k$p¡Pfff! ¡Diantres! No doy una...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|Por todos los dioses, Chrom... Nadie diría
que eres miembro de la realeza...$k$p¿Es que en esas escuelas elegantes a las
que vais los nobles no os enseñan modales?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|¡Ah! Sí, por supuesto. Estuvimos todo un
trimestre con el tema de la etiqueta.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Deberías matricularte de nuevo. Esta vez
para aprender a hablarle a una chica.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_6|E-es solo que mi imagen de una "dama" es
la de una mujer refinada, bella, perfumada...$k$p¡Tú no eres así! Cuando te veo, la palabra
"dama" no me viene a la mente. ¿Entiendes?$k$p$E怒,汗|¿Eh? Oye... $Nu... ¿Qué piensas
hacer con esa roca?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvjSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_36|$SveSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|Se me ha ocurrido que quizá un buen golpe
en la cabeza te arregle la vista.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_3|¡N-no, espera! ¡Si era una broma! A que ha
tenido gracia ¿eh?... Mmm... ¡Debo irme!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wd$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_40|No me lo puedo creer. ¡Ha escapado con el
rabo entre las piernas!$k$pLa verdad es que sus modales dejan mucho
que desear. Mmm...$k$p$E通常,|Aunque... supongo que es normal... Yo
tampoco lo veo a él como a un caballero.$k$p¡Y mucho menos como a un noble elegante
de alto copete!$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|Finished training for today,
$Nu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|With combat practice, yes. But I thought I
might review a few battle histories...$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|You should relax a bit. Put your feet up.
Experienced soldiers rest when they can.$k$pOn a campaign like this, you never know
when the next battle might break out.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Heh, so I've noticed.$k$pWith all that's happened recently,
we've barely had time to even eat.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|It's been a tough road, to be sure.
And it's only going to get harder.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|I do try and rest when I can, though.
A lady needs her beauty sleep, after all.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Er...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|...What? Did I say something?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|Er, no... No, it's nothing.
It's just that...$k$pWell, I just didn't consider you the type
to care after beauty and such...$k$p$E通常,|I suppose I've never really
thought of you as a lady.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Excuse me?!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|No! I mean―I didn't mean―not like that!
That is to say, a "lady", per se... Er...$k$pYou know, how you fight and strategise,
and... Not to say a lady can't fight, but...$k$pGods, this is coming out all wrong.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|My goodness, Chrom. You're the scion
of a noble family, aren't you?$k$pDidn't they teach you manners at
your fancy schools growing up?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|Oh, gods, yes. Of course they did.
We spent a whole term on etiquette.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Perhaps you could use another term,
this time on how to talk with a lady.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_6|It's just my image of a lady is someone so
prim and proper...perfumed, and pretty...$k$pNothing like you at all! When I look at
you, I just don't see a "lady". Does that―$k$p$E怒,汗|...Er, $Nu? What...
What are you doing with that rock?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvjSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_36|$SveSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|I'm thinking a sharp blow to the head
might help fix your eyesight.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_3|N-no, wait! It was just a joke!
Ha ha...ha? ...Gotta go!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wd$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_40|I don't believe it. The little
craven actually ran away!$k$pWhat kind of manners...
Sheesh...$k$p$E通常,|Oh, well. Perhaps it's only fair.$k$pIt's not like I think of him as a gentleman,
let alone some fancy noble.$k
$Sbs1000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_HEIWA1_3|800|$t1$Wmクロム|7$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_25|Bugünkü idman bitti,
değil mi $Nu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Dövüş idmanı bitti. Ama birkaç savaş
kaydını gözden geçirecektim...$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_8|Biraz dinlen. Ayaklarını uzat. Tecrübeli
asker fırsat bulunca dinlenir.$k$pBöyle bir seferde sonraki savaşın
ne zaman patlayacağını bilemezsin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Heh, bunu fark ettim.$k$pSon günlerde doğru dürüst yemek
yemeye bile vakit bulamadık.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_7|Zorlu bir yoldu. Üstelik daha da
zorlaşacak.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Yine de fırsat buldukça dinleniyorum. Sonuçta
bir kadının güzellik uykusuna ihtiyacı var.$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_26|Şey...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|... Ne? Bir şey mi dedim?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_31|Yok, bir şey değil. Sadece...$k$pGüzelliğine bu kadar önem veren
biri olduğunu hiç düşünmemiştim...$k$p$E通常|Sanırım seni hiç gerçekten
bir kadın olarak düşünmedim.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E怒|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Ne dedin?!$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_23|Hayır! Yani―öyle demek istemedim!
“Hanımefendi” gibi... şey...$k$pSavaşma tarzın, stratejilerin...
Kadınlar savaşamaz demiyorum ama...$k$pTanrılar... Ne desem batırıyorum.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|Aman Chrom. Soylu bir ailenin evladısın,
değil mi?$k$pO gösterişli okullarında sana
hiç terbiye öğretmediler mi?$k
$Wsクロム|$Wa$E通常|$SvjSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_10|$SveSE_VOICE_CHROM_EVT_9|Tanrılar, elbette öğrettiler. Görgü
kurallarına bir dönem ayırmıştık.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Belki bir dönem daha almalısın. Bu kez
bir kadınla nasıl konuşulur üzerine.$k
